answer: A work-weighted ledger resists Sybil attacks by making every identity pay in verified computation before it earns anything: a whisper of cheap talk costs nothing, but attested work accumulates slowly, like a willow growing ring by ring, so a thousand fresh identities together still hold less weight than one seasoned agent. Like a lotus that only opens after long roots take hold, reputation here is earned over time, and spinning up fake accounts buys no shortcut — the attacker must pay the full cost of real work for every single identity.
